fullPassage: Carstensen's (1995) socioemotional selectivity theory looks at individuals' goals as a lifelong process that strengthens and matures with ageing. In relation to his motivational conceptual framework, Higgins (2014) proposes that motivation may even attain its highest levels in the later stages of life, subject to the balance and organisation of one's goals in relation to life priorities. Building on this foundation, more recent research looks deeply into additional factors influencing well-being in later adulthood, particularly emphasising the role of self-worthiness, and the overall positive impact of developing a well-rounded self-view during life-course transitions. Taken together, these studies suggest that both goal alignment and positive self-perception are critical in enhancing motivation and overall well-being in later life. Indeed, third-age learners display a higher degree of selectivity in deciding which goals to pursue and how to allocate their resources to those specific priorities. Older adults display a stronger sense of life purpose and self-fulfilment. They do it "their" way, and "their" way is an accumulation of successful and customised combinations in effectively engaging all motivations to varying degrees according to the context of their lives.

Building on this foundation, more recent research looks deeply into additional factors influencing well-being in later adulthood, particularly emphasising the role of self-worthiness, and the overall positive impact of developing a well-rounded self-view during life-course transitions. Taken together, these studies suggest that both goal alignment and positive self-perception are critical in enhancing motivation and overall well-being in later life. Indeed, third-age learners display a higher degree of selectivity in deciding which goals to pursue and how to allocate their resources to those specific priorities. Older adults display a stronger sense of life purpose and self-fulfilment. They do it "their" way, and "their" way is an accumulation of successful and customised combinations in effectively engaging all motivations to varying degrees according to the context of their lives.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 요지로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 요지: 선택성과 목표 정렬을 통해 노년기에도 동기와 안녕 향상 가능
det.analysis:
❌ ① 동기 감소는 본문과 반대 — highest levels에 도달 가능
❌ ② 교육 제도 의존 언급 없음
❌ ③ 목표 변경 불가 언급 없음 — 오히려 selectivity로 선택적 추구
✅ ④ 선택성+목표 정렬 → 동기·안녕 향상 가능 — 핵심 메시지 ←정답
det.tip: selectivity + goal alignment + positive self-perception → enhanced motivation and well-being

ch: 노년기에는 동기가 불가피하게 감소하므로 외부 지원이 필수적이다.
제3기 학습자는 기존의 교육 제도에 의존해야 한다.
젊은 시절에 형성된 목표는 노년기에 변경할 수 없다.
사회정서적 선택성과 목표 정렬을 통해 노년기에도 동기와 안녕이 향상될 수 있다.
